d:
Bihar ke gopalganj kuchaykot prakhand ke sasamusa bajar ke samip pravahit hone vali banganga nadi, jise sthaniy star par daha nadi ke nam se jana jata hai, lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke dauran bhakti aur vishvas ka pramukh kendr ban jati hai. nadi ke is pavan tat ko pure kshetr men 'mannat ghat' ke nam se pukara jata hai.
